content: Laappunththa Layththa Shempo
GODAY Siina zuma bollan Muse hizgi azazides,
«Ne Isra7eele asaas, ‹Tani inttes immiza biitta intte geliza wode laappunththa laappunththa layththan biitta goyontta shaachchi shempison Xoossa bonchchite.
Usuppun layath kumeth goyitenne zerite; woyne miththay lo7eththi ayfana mala qirxite; ayfekka maxi shiishshite.
Gido attiin laappunththa layththay taas Xoossaas dumma gidiin biittay shemppo demmiza layth gido; he layth biitta goyopite; woyne miththayka ayfana mala qirxofte.
Intte zerontta azabba caarida kaththaa inttes maxi shiishshofte; he layththay biittaya mulera shempiza layththa.
He layth iza aykkoka goyontta aggikokka biittaya inttes intte aylletasinne inttes miishshara ooththizaytas; qasseka hara dereppe yiidi inttenara diza hara yeletatas mizaaz gido.
Intte mehetassinne intte biitta bolla diza do7atassara meetettizaaz biittaya immana; he iza immizayssi ubbay isttas meetettizaaz gido.
Wozzo Layth
« ‹Laappunto laappun layth qooda; he layththata qooday oyddu tammanne uddufun layth gidees;
Laappunththo aginay gelidaappe tammanththa gallas bonchchettiza nagarappe maareteththa gallas kumeththa biittaa bolla zaye zayanaade yeddite.

Hessaththoka ichchash tammanththo layththaa dummasi shaakkidi biittay bolla dizaytas ubbaas wozzeteth awajjite; hayssafe kase bayzettida gadey kase bayzidaades woykko izaade qommos simmo; aylleteththan bayzettida aylleyka kase ba asaakko simmo.
He layth goshshe goyidi zereth zeropite; zereth zerontta coo azabba kaxxida kath woykko qirxettontta ayfida woyne miththa ayfe maxi shiishshofte.
He layththay kumeth inttes dumma shaakettida layth gido; kase intte zerontta coo barkka kaxxida kath xalla miite.
« ‹Hayssafe kase bayzettida gadey ubbay he wozzo layththan gadaades simmo.
Hessa gishshas ne asho gidida Isra7eele asaa neni gade bayzidaaz gidikko woykko ne haa nees shammidaaz gidikko gene ooso ooththofa.
Gadeza waagay heregettanaas bessizay sinththafe biittay simmiza layththay gakkanaappe kase he gadey immana dandayza kaththa qoppi hereganaas bessees.
Layththay daro gidikko heregaykka daro gido; layththay guuth gidikko heregaykka guuth gido; gadey bayzettiza waagay gadezi immiza kaththaa mala gido.
Issi Isra7eele asi hara Isra7eele as qohoppo; intte intte Xoossaas yayyite; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
Laappunththa Layththan Yaana Meto
« ‹Intte intte biittaa bolla saron de7ana mala Xoossa woga ubbaa bonchchite.
Biittaya inttes gidana kath immana; intteka izippe kallana gakkanaas maana; saroteththanka de7ana.
« ‹Gido attiin laappunththa layththan goshshe goyonttanne kath zerontta maxontta ay maanee?› giidi oychchiza asi dontta aggenna.
Usuppunththa layththatan biittayo anjjana; histtiko iza inttes heedzdzu layththas gidana kath immana.
Osppunththa layththankka goshshe goyishe intte kase shiishshida kaththaa maana; hessa he kaththaa uddufunththa layththan bone kath intte shiishshana gakkanaas izappe maana.
Bayzettida Aqota Wozzo
« ‹Gadey wozzettontta mala bayzanaas bessenna; gaasoykka biittay taassa attiin iza inttes gidukku; intte imaththatanne bete asata mala.
« ‹Biittay bayzettiko he bayzizaadey he biittaa zaari wozzanayssi erettidaaz gido.
Isra7eele asaappe issaadey metoppe attanaas ba gade bayzikko izas matiza dabboy he bayzettida gadaa wozzo.
Izas wozziza mata dabboy dontta aggiko izaadey gam7ishe miishshe demmidi zaari wozzanaas dandayees.
Hessa wozzanaas izi dandayza wode ba bayzida wodezappe doommidi diza layththaa qoodidi attida layththata miishshaa shammidaades zaaro; hessafe guye kase ba gadeza zaari ekko.

Qasseka gadeza wozzanaas gidiza miishshi izas dontta aggiko izi bayzida gadey wozzettiza layththay gakkanaas shammidaade kushen de7o; wozzettiza layththay gakkishin gadey gadaades simmo; gadaadeyka gede ba gaden simmo.
« ‹Issi asi gimbey gimbettida katama giddon diza keeth bayzidaa gidikko izi bayzidaappe issi layththa garsan zaari wozzanaas dandayees; izi zaari wozzana dandayzay issi layththa garsan xalla.

Gidikkoka issi layththa garsan zaari wozzanaas dandayontta aggiko hara wode zaari wozzisiza wogay izas deenna; keeththay shammidaades woykko iza naa naas haaro gidi attees; bayzettida miishshay wozzettiza layththankka bayzidaades keeththay simmenna.
Gimbey gimbettontta coo dere garsan diza keeththati bayzettidaappe guye goshsha biitta mala qoodettidi keeththa goday zaari wozzanaas dandayees.
« ‹Gido attiin Lewe nayti baas imettida katamatan diza ba keeththata ba koyida ay wodekka wozzanaas dandayeettes.

Hayti katamatan issi Lewe qommoy keeth bayzikko qasse zaari wozzanaas izi dandayontta aggiko bayzettida miish wozzo layththan izas simmo; gaasoykka Lewe qommoti ba katamatan keexxida keeththati Isra7eele nayta giddon ay wode gakkanaaska isttassa.
Qasseka istti katamata yuushon diza mehey heemettiza biittay mulekka bayzettofo; he biittay ay wodekka isttassa.
Manqotas Tal7e Imo Woga
« ‹Ne bagga Isra7eele asaappe issaadey manqidi bana ayssanaas dandayonttaade gidikko imaththa gidida woykko bete asi ne achchan daana mala ne maaddizayssaththo izakka maadda.
Ne bagga gidida Isra7eele asi nenara daana mala izappe dich mooppa; ne Xoossas yayya.
Ne izas tal7e immiko izappe dich oychchofa; ne kath izas wodhera bayzoppa.
Nena Kanaane biitta laatissanaas nees GODAA gidanaas Gibxe biittafe kessida Xoossay tana.
Aylleteththafe Wozzeteth
« ‹Ne bagga gidida Isra7eele asaappe issaadey manqoteththaafe dendidayssan aylle mala nees haarettanaas bana bayzikko ne iza aylle mala oosisoppa.
Ne iza ne matan diza imaththa mala woykko miishshas ooththiza oosanchcha mala qooda; izikka ichchashu tammu layth gakkanaas nees ooththo.
Hessafe guye ba naytara neeppe shaaketti gede baso asakkonne ba duussaso simmo.
Isra7eele asaa ta Gibxe biittafe kessida ta oosanchchata gidida gishshas istti aylle mala bayzettofetto.
Ne istta wolqqara haaroppa; ne Xoossaas yayya.
« ‹Nees attumanne macca aylleti de7ana mala koykko ne yuushon diza Ayzaabeta giddofe shamma ekka.
Qasseka intte biittan diza bete asatappenne intte biittan yelettida asatappe shammanaas dandayeeta; istti inttes haaro gidetto.
Heytan intte intte nayta laatissanaas dandayeeta; istti de7iza layththa ubbaan intte naytas ooththizayta gidana; intte qommo gidida Isra7eele as wolqqara haaropite.
« ‹Intte giddon diza hara dere asaappe issaadey dure gidikko intte bagga gidida Isra7eele naytappe manqo gididay bana hara dere dures woykko izaso asaappe issaades bana aylleteththas aaththi immiko,
izi bayzettidaappe guye simmidi nam7anththo wozzettanaas dandayees; hessa gishshas iza ishatappe issaadey iza wozzo.
Iza aawaa ishay woykko iza aawaa isha nay woykko izas mata dabbotappe issaadey iza zaari wozzanaas dandayees; izaadey baas gidiza miishshe shiishshidaa gidikko ba miishshara wozzettanaas dandayees.

Izi bana haaridaadera issife gididi izi bana barkka bayzida layththaafe doommidi wozzeteththa layththaa gakkanaas diza layththaa qoodo; iza wozzisiza miishshay he layththata qooda gido; izi bana haarizayssara gam7ida wode waagay issi asi ooththidi demmiza kira miishsha keena gido.
Wozzo layththay gakkanaas buro daro layththati attidaa gidikko ba bayzettida waagaappe he attida layththaa qoodan bana wozziza waagaa qanxxo.
He attida layththati guuth gidikko ba haarettiin attida layththaa qoodidi bana wozziza waaga qanxxo.
Izi layththafe layth gakkanaas une
ooththiza asa mala bana haaridaadera de7oppe attiin iza wolqqara haaranaas bessenna.
« ‹Hessaththo hanidi wozzettanaas dandayontta aggiko sinththafe yaana aylleteththafe wozzettiza layththan izinne iza nayti mela yedettetto.
Isra7eele asay taas aylletanne tani Gibxe biittafe kessida ta oosanchchata; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.

footnotes.text: Une: Une gizayssa kira gi go7ettana dandayettees.
